Design

Art gaps and production gates

No verified archive frames or 3D environment content are supplied with this documentation edition.

On this page
Blocked evidenceRequired additional workFallback policy

Blocked evidence

Exact ZIP inventory, dimensions, palette variants, page pairing, frame/timing guide and license redistribution are unavailable. The prompt reports four directions and several profession/weapon pages; this edition does not promote those reports to measured facts.

Required additional work

Audit swims, jump/dodge/land, cast/channel/heal, emotes, enemy/NPC families and every equipment page combination. Author missing diagonal frames for every supported action/layer before claiming eight directions. Mounted body/gear/locomotion/swim/attack compatibility is a separate art and movement gate.

Build/license 3D landscapes/roads/stairs/bridges/interiors/water/trees/rocks/props and original effects/audio. A rod overlay is not a fishing ecosystem, and a tree-chopping pose is not a tree mesh.

Fallback policy

Use developer-authored rights-cleared direction glyphs and simple primitives for technical tests. Label them debug. Missing equipment overlays hide visual layers while stats remain valid. Missing body art uses readable debug presentation; do not ship invisible actors or misleadingly label placeholders as finished. Preserve common body IDs so later art can replace visuals without rewriting persistence.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
